items.title: Anthropic releases Claude Fable 5.2 and Mythos 5.2
items.summary: Anthropic shipped new versions of its top models with gains in coding, reasoning and vision. Fable's input price drops from $10 to $8 per million tokens and it responds about 30% faster across effort levels; faster inference serving costs double.
items.whyItMatters: A cheaper, faster Fable lowers the cost of the LLM brain behind tutor feedback and lesson generation, though no voice or French-specific changes were announced.

items.title: Meta releases Muse Ember, a cheap multimodal model for agent tasks
items.summary: Ember is Meta's lightest Muse model, priced at $0.10 per million input tokens, and handles text, images and audio including recordings. Meta pitches it for tool calls, routing and extraction, paired with the larger Muse Wonder as planner.
items.whyItMatters: A very cheap audio-aware model could handle background jobs like transcript analysis, error tagging and routing in the tutor at a fraction of current cost; French quality is unverified.

items.title: Otter adds 27 languages and mid-meeting language switching
items.summary: Otter's own speech models now cover 13 new languages (German, Italian, Mandarin and others) with 14 more coming, for 31 total. An upcoming feature detects language changes mid-conversation without manual settings. French is not in the new batch.
items.whyItMatters: Automatic mid-conversation language detection is exactly what a learner code-switching between English and French needs from the tutor's ASR.

items.title: Jensen Huang pulls out of ElevenLabs Summit amid Nvidia controversy
items.summary: ElevenLabs confirmed the Nvidia CEO withdrew from its New York summit, scheduled for this Wednesday. Nvidia is an ElevenLabs investor.
items.whyItMatters: The summit may bring ElevenLabs product news relevant to Anna, so it's worth watching this week.
